fusions.name: Past the Cape
fusions.desc: A hooking horn thrust that deals 22 damage, consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.2 times their remaining damage to the hit, and leaves it [Bleeding] for 5 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Loop and Dally
fusions.desc: Throws a rope loop at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 7 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and leaves it 30% slower for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Waving Red
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 15% for 10 seconds, and draws up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Quilted Caparison
fusions.desc: Conjures a quilted caparison over your hide: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 8%, your dodge chance rises by 4%, and 4% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
